analysis.summary_en: The open-source AI agent management system.
highlights: Authentication: OAuth 2.0 with Keycloak, role-based access, and enforced token audience.
Open protocols. EDDI is an MCP server (120 tools) and an MCP client, speaks A2A, and can serve deployed agents through an OpenAI-compatible /v1 API (off by default).
Secrets vault: envelope encryption (PBKDF2 and AES-256-GCM) with key rotation.
Run. Agents work alone or as a team, with any of 19 model providers, local models included, on your own servers. It installs with one Docker command or on Kubernetes and OpenShift, on Mongo…
